items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: And there wasn't a ballad singer who came to the top until Billy Eckstein.

ctx.x: Well, that may be true for movies but what about music --

And there wasn't a ballad singer who came to the top until Billy Eckstein. You know, Billy Daniels was singing those ballads long before Eckstein and couldn't get to first base. All the fans would come to Harlem to hear Billy Daniels sing in a dive before he went baritone and shot up like magic. But Billy Eckstein got big just singing romantic ballads (inaudible) in New York. Just like Frank Sinatra or something.

But see, times change. And back in those days, of course, I was fortunate with that Goodman thing to be able to perform with dignity and get in the top world of publicity and before a big, mass public with Goodman. And with that sort of organization, it was perfect for me to be that way, you know.
